The four ORCA 6 single points of `cadmia prepare bsse 1tial_d4/1tial_CO2.out` (PBE0/def2-TZVP D4,
RIJCOSX, ghost atoms), host and paths replaced. They sit apart from 1tial_d4/ so that a glob of
that folder still gives only the eight outputs of the demonstration.
  BSSE = (E_cl_own − E_cl_full) + (E_pr_own − E_pr_full) = 0.002370571 Ha (1.4876 kcal/mol)
The Gaussian counterpoise job on the same geometry (gaussian_cp/1tial_CO2_cp.out) gives 1.5236.
